2. **[UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents](https://arxiv.org/html/2507.22034v1)** — Tests multi-turn interactions with simulated users who gradually reveal preferences, requiring clarification and tool use. **People:** Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC), Heng Ji (UIUC), and Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Zhiwei Liu, Jianguo Zhang, Haolin Chen, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).

Particularly relevant for checking whether simulated-user evaluations reflect human judgments. **People:** Yao Dou, Alan Ritter, Wei Xu (Georgia Tech); Michel Galley, Baolin Peng, Chris Kedzie, Weixin Cai, Chris Quirk, Jianfeng Gao (Microsoft).

query: methods improving user-centric agents with simulated users
text:
1. **[UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning](https://lifelongagent.github.io/Project-Lifelong-Agent/UserRL/index.html)** (2025). Trains agents with simulated users, studying how reward design and simulator choice improve multi-turn interaction. **People:** Cheng Qian and Heng Ji (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign); Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).

2. **[Training Proactive and Personalized LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/html/2511.02208v1)** (2025). Introduces **UserVille**, populated by simulated users with configurable preferences, and **PPP**, reinforcement learning that rewards task completion, useful clarification, and personalization. **People:** Weiwei Sun, Xuhui Zhou, Weihua Du, Sean Welleck, Graham Neubig, Maarten Sap, and Yiming Yang (Carnegie Mellon University), and Xingyao Wang (OpenHands).

Uses evolutionary search to generate diverse, realistic simulated-user behaviors.
